reason: The patch makes zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts:92 pass the literal "zoomvideo" as appSlug, and refreshOAuthTokens.ts sends it to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT. Zoom's slug is "zoom" (zoomvideo/_metadata.ts:16), and the new webhook app-credential.ts looks the app up with prisma.app.findUnique({where:{slug}}), so the two sides name Zoom differently.
